verdict.rationale: Honeycomb ingests traces, logs, and metrics all via OpenTelemetry into one dataset, and query builder supports trace-relational fields (root./parent./child.) so users can correlate span data within a trace, but the evidence pack contains no explicit UI feature or workflow described as 'click a span to jump to correlated logs/metrics.' Community evidence even shows practitioners still pivoting across separate tools (OpenSearch, Prometheus) for logs/metrics during incidents, suggesting cross-signal jumps aren't always seamless in practice. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a span-to-logs/metrics jump UI or workflow, independent hands-on confirmation that correlation works end-to-end within Honeycomb alone.
